cat << 'EOF' > /work/refine_plant_table_couch.py
import cv2
import numpy as np
import json
import math
from check_ground_contact_close import ground_point

with open('/work/poses.json') as f:
    poses = json.load(f)

# 1. Plant 1 pot bottom in Frame 23 (pose: -1.116, 3.433, h=300):
img23 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0023.png')
# Pot is terracotta
pot_mask23 = (img23[:, :, 2] > 140) & (img23[:, :, 0] < 80) & (img23[:, :, 1] < 120)
ys, xs = np.where(pot_mask23)
print(f"Plant 1 in 23: bottom v={ys.max()}, u={np.mean(xs):.1f}")
print("Plant 1 pos from 23 ground contact:", ground_point(23, np.mean(xs), ys.max()))

# 2. Plant 2 pot bottom in Frame 39 (pose: 0.920, 3.970, h=240):
img39 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0039.png')
# Plant 2 is on the right in 39 (u ~ 380)
pot_mask39 = (img39[:, :, 2] > 140) & (img39[:, :, 0] < 80) & (img39[:, :, 1] < 120)
pot_mask39[:, :300] = 0
ys, xs = np.where(pot_mask39)
print(f"Plant 2 in 39: bottom v={ys.max()}, u={np.mean(xs):.1f}")
print("Plant 2 pos from 39 ground contact:", ground_point(39, np.mean(xs), ys.max()))

# 3. Table in Frame 40 (pose: 0.920, 3.970, h=300):
img40 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0040.png')
# Table legs contact with ground:
# Wood color:
table_mask40 = (img40[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img40[:, :, 2] < 170) & \
               (img40[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img40[:, :, 1] < 100) & \
               (img40[:, :, 0] < 60)
# Table is foreground, leg bottoms:
ys, xs = np.where(table_mask40)
# lowest pixels are table leg bottoms
print(f"Table in 40: bottom v={ys.max()}, center u={np.mean(xs):.1f}")
print("Table pos from 40 ground contact:", ground_point(40, np.mean(xs), ys.max()))

# 4. Sofa in Frame 35 & 36:
# Frame 35: pose (0.488, 4.720, h=30)
# Frame 36: pose (0.920, 4.970, h=60)
img36 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0036.png')
hsv36 = cv2.cvtColor(img36, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
couch_mask36 = cv2.inRange(hsv36, (100, 20, 50), (130, 150, 200))
ys, xs = np.where(couch_mask36)
print(f"Sofa in 36: bottom v={ys.max()}, center u={np.mean(xs):.1f}")
print("Sofa pos from 36 ground contact:", ground_point(36, np.mean(xs), ys.max()))
